create.doc: Exchange an HTTP Authorization header credential for a short-lived opaque token. The credential is stored via the authn_store procedure and the generated token is returned to the caller for subsequent authenticated requests.

Authorization.doc: Standard HTTP Authorization header (e.g. Basic or Bearer scheme). Read from the request header, not the request body.

token.doc: 22-character opaque authentication token generated by uniqueId(22) and persisted via the authn_store stored procedure

errors.message: Authorization header is missing or malformed
Failed to persist token via authn_store procedure
